name: Kaijin
source:
Player can choose to become either a monster or Akechi. As a monster, humiliate Rina as much as possible. As Akechi, help Rina and enjoy your reward.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-december-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
玩家可以选择成为怪物或明智。作为怪物，尽可能的羞辱莉娜。作为明智，帮助莉娜并享受你的奖励。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-december-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
